description: READ-ONLY. FBA orders as physically fulfilled by Amazon (report Amazon Fulfilled Shipments, GENERAL variant — no buyer PII): per order, the fulfillment-center-id each item shipped FROM and the derived ship-from country. Use when the user needs to know FROM WHICH COUNTRY an FBA order departed — typical case: choosing the correct VAT regime on manually issued invoices for marketplaces without Amazon automatic invoicing (amazon.ae, amazon.sa). ship_from_country is best-effort from the FC code; the authoritative datum is fulfillment_center_id. Async SP-API report: the first call may take ~30-60s.

account_id.description: ID dell'outpost Amazon (= un seller su uno specifico marketplace; vedi list_clients). Opzionale se il token è legato a un solo outpost.

days.description: Shipment-date lookback window in days (1-30, default 7)

name: get_fulfilled_shipments
